question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE subject_catalog AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  academic_year AS academic_year,
  subject_id AS subject_id,
  subject_code AS subject_code,
  subject_number AS subject_number,
  department_code AS department_code,
  department_name AS department_name,
  hgn_desc AS hgn_desc
FROM beaver."cis_course_catalog"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE subject_code_lookup AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  subject_code AS subject_code,
  subject_code_desc AS subject_code_desc
FROM beaver."sis_subject_code"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_catalog" AS SELECT DISTINCT
  academic_year AS academic_year,
  subject_id AS subject_id,
  subject_code AS subject_code,
  subject_number AS subject_number,
  department_code AS department_code,
  department_name AS department_name,
  hgn_desc AS hgn_desc
FROM beaver."cis_course_catalog"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_code_lookup" AS SELECT DISTINCT
  subject_code AS subject_code,
  subject_code_desc AS subject_code_desc
FROM beaver."sis_subject_code"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_catalog" AS SELECT 
  academic_year,
  subject_id,
  subject_code,
  subject_number,
  department_code,
  department_name,
  hgn_desc,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns
FROM subject_catalog

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subject_code_lookup" AS SELECT 
  subject_code,
  subject_code_desc,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns
FROM subject_code_lookup

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        sc.department_name,
        sc.subject_code,
        COALESCE(scl.subject_code_desc, sc.subject_code) AS subject_code_desc,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sc.hgn_desc,'')) LIKE '%graduate%' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Undergraduate/Other' END AS graduate_level
    FROM subject_catalog sc
    LEFT JOIN subject_code_lookup scl
      ON UPPER(TRIM(sc.subject_code)) = UPPER(TRIM(scl.subject_code))
), counts AS (
    SELECT 
        department_name,
        subject_code,
        graduate_level,
        COUNT(*) AS total_courses
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            sc.department_name,
            sc.subject_code,
            CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sc.hgn_desc,'')) LIKE '%graduate%' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Undergraduate/Other' END AS graduate_level,
            sc.subject_id
        FROM subject_catalog sc
    ) d
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT 
    b.department_name,
    b.subject_code,
    b.subject_code_desc,
    b.graduate_level,
    c.total_courses
FROM base b
JOIN counts c
  ON c.department_name = b.department_name
 AND c.subject_code = b.subject_code
 AND c.graduate_level = b.graduate_level
ORDER BY b.department_name, b.subject_code, b.graduate_level;

# Create aggregated view with department, subject code, description, graduate flag, and total courses per department

# We interpret graduate_level as case-insensitive match where hgn_desc contains 'Graduate'; otherwise 'Undergraduate/Other'.

import pandas as pd

# Build aggregated table via SQL joins and grouping
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        sc.department_name,
        sc.subject_code,
        COALESCE(scl.subject_code_desc, sc.subject_code) AS subject_code_desc,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sc.hgn_desc,'')) LIKE '%graduate%' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Undergraduate/Other' END AS graduate_level
    FROM subject_catalog sc
    LEFT JOIN subject_code_lookup scl
      ON UPPER(TRIM(sc.subject_code)) = UPPER(TRIM(scl.subject_code))
), counts AS (
    SELECT 
        department_name,
        subject_code,
        graduate_level,
        COUNT(*) AS total_courses
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            sc.department_name,
            sc.subject_code,
            CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(sc.hgn_desc,'')) LIKE '%graduate%' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Undergraduate/Other' END AS graduate_level,
            sc.subject_id
        FROM subject_catalog sc
    ) d
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT 
    b.department_name,
    b.subject_code,
    b.subject_code_desc,
    b.graduate_level,
    c.total_courses
FROM base b
JOIN counts c
  ON c.department_name = b.department_name
 AND c.subject_code = b.subject_code
 AND c.graduate_level = b.graduate_level
ORDER BY b.department_name, b.subject_code, b.graduate_level;
'''
